raw_contract.coordinates: registered upper/lower STL in their original common coordinate system; never independently aligned arches
raw_contract.labels: shared live DADSN per-vertex FDI labels

features.concat_raw_reference: posterior 52 + anterior 45 in the frozen feature_schema order

classifier.C_policy: median of frozen selected outer-fold C values [0.05,0.1,0.05,0.025,0.025]; no candidate reselection
mode of frozen selected outer-fold C values [0.025,0.025,0.025,0.025,0.1]; no candidate reselection

crossbite_present.threshold_policy: median of frozen selected outer-fold thresholds [0.485,0.715,0.565,0.815,0.81]; no threshold optimization on full data

side_classifier.C_policy: mode of frozen selected outer-fold C values [0.05,0.1,0.05,0.05,0.05]

crossbite_location.bilateral_scale_policy: median of frozen selected outer-fold scales [1.0,1.0,0.75,0.5,0.75]

deployment_training: One full-cohort train using only these fixed families, feature columns, preprocessing, parameters, thresholds, and label policies. No OOF rerun or candidate comparison.
